newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta slips versus mark on France EMU comments.
newsitem.headline: Peseta slips versus mark on France EMU comments.

text.p: The Spanish peseta slipped lower against the mark on Monday at midday as remarks from France over Europe's economic and monetary union (EMU) revived fears that Europe's single currency could be delayed, dealers said.

France's new Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said more time was needed to discuss the so-called stability pact on fiscal discipline after EMU is launched. He added that France needed more time to discuss the economic pillars of the union.
By 1125 GMT the peseta had fallen to 84.77/4.80 per mark versus 84.62/65 in early trade and levels seen late on Friday of 84.58/61.
France also reiterated that it was determined to maintain the EMU schedule.
The dollar's weakness was seen as another factor adding to the peseta fall.
